text: I'm sorry for the long message, I'm the grandmother and I've been up with him since yesterday and I'm worn right out. My grandson is 11, he's had a fever since yesterday afternoon and tonight it's 39. He has a rash on his chest and tummy, raised reddish bumps, and when I pressed a drinking glass on those they went paler, so I wasn't too bothered about those. But with his dark skin it's hard to see much of anything, so my daughter told me to look at the lighter places. I looked at the palms of his hands and the bottoms of his feet and there are little dots there, dark reddish purple, like someone pricked him with a pin lots of times. I pulled down his bottom eyelid too and there's a couple of the same tiny dots on the inside. I pressed the glass on his palm and those ones stayed, they didn't go anywhere, not like the ones on his chest. He's not had any shaking or jerking or anything like that, nothing of that kind. I just don't know if those little dots are something or if I'm too tired to be looking properly. His mum's on the way but she's an hour off.
